whenToUse: You split different aspects of the same thing, such as details, reviews, and shipping.
People only need to see one group of information at a time.
There are about two to six tabs with short labels.
whenNotToUse: People need to compare the contents of several panels at once.
The steps must be done in order.
There are so many tabs that the sideways scroll gets long.

alternatives.name: Segmented Control
alternatives.reason: Switching how the same data is shown.

alternatives.name: Accordion
alternatives.reason: Several sections stacked vertically on mobile.

accessibility: Connect the parts with role="tablist", "tab", and "tabpanel" plus aria-selected and aria-controls.
With a roving tabIndex, one Tab enters the tab list and the left and right arrows move between tabs.
Home and End move to the first and last tab.
Give the panel tabIndex=0 so keyboard users can reach its content directly.
